parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the instance ID.

>  You must specify at least one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

>  You must specify at least one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than **0** and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: ParentChannelId
parameters.description: The parent task ID of the distributed task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-consumer-channel --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id dtsboss6pn1w000000 --dts-job-id boss6pn1w000000 --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --parent-channel-id dtsan5114c52000000 --resource-group-id rg-aek3dcgyq7pnqwa --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeConsumerChannel --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId boss6pn1w000000 --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek3dcgyq7pnqwa' --PageNumber 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ParentChannelId dtsan5114c52000000 --DtsInstanceId dtsboss6pn1w000000
